0<VCC<2.3V switch isolation, unpowered SENSE backfeed, target collapse, host ramps/hotplug/inrush, capacitor joint extremes and USB function/ESD remain unproven physically. Ioff atVCC=0 cannot be extended to intermediate rail.

Printed fit, cable/crimp/strain relief and connector retention, full MPN tolerances, battery/thermal/load/fault behavior, functional S3 product firmware and separate four-hour runs on both devices remain outstanding.
